scope_note: Tunisia's coast forms THREE natural short-hop sub-networks: (1) the Gulf of Tunis around the capital, (2) the Sahel resort coast (Hammamet-Sousse-Monastir), and (3) Djerba island in the Gulf of Gabes. Deepen Tunis + Djerba and add the Sahel cities (real, sourced) so the market reads as a genuine network, not two orphan pins.
no_invention_rule: Every BP and city is a real named place with a source URL. New cities (Sousse/Monastir/Hammamet, Bizerte) are legitimate sourced registry additions, not inventions. Grok does deterministic ID-match + coords + seal.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Sidi Bou Said Marina
boarding_point_candidates.note: Basin cut into the cliff below the blue-and-white village, ~4 nm north of Tunis; also cited by Imray.

boarding_point_candidates.name: La Goulette yacht club / port
boarding_point_candidates.note: On the sandbar between Lake Tunis and the Gulf of Tunis; yacht club + cruise + ferry gateway to Tunis/Carthage.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Gammarth / La Marsa waterfront
boarding_point_candidates.note: Northern beach-resort stretch of the Gulf of Tunis above Sidi Bou Said.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Cross the inner Gulf of Tunis and round Cap Carthage headland offshore; do not cut across the Carthage promontory.
Round the Sidi Bou Said / Cap Carthage headland to the north beach.

new_city.name: Bizerte
new_city.note: Northernmost Tunisian city; historic old port + marina + yacht club on a lagoon channel.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Bizerte marina / old port
boarding_point_candidates.note: Marina and yacht club at the mouth of the Bizerte lagoon channel.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Follow the north coast SE; round Cap Farina / Cap Zebib headlands with offshore waypoints. Near N30 range edge -- verify duty cycle.

new_cities.name: Yasmine Hammamet
new_cities.note: Purpose-built marina resort town on the Gulf of Hammamet; one of Tunisia's three wintering marinas.

new_cities.name: Sousse (Port El Kantaoui)
new_cities.note: Port El Kantaoui purpose-built marina ~10 km north of Sousse; major Sahel resort.

new_cities.name: Monastir
new_cities.note: Cap Monastir Marina: full-service, 400 berths, yachts up to 40 m.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Yasmine Hammamet Marina
boarding_point_candidates.note: Large marina + medina resort on the Gulf of Hammamet.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Coastal run south across the Gulf of Hammamet; offshore waypoint to clear the Hammamet/Sousse shoals.
Round Cap Monastir headland offshore into the marina basin.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Marina Djerba (Houmt Souk Marina)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Main Djerba marina at Houmt Souk (existing anchor).

boarding_point_candidates.name: Ajim port (Djerba west)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Djerba's west-point ferry port; the island's mainland link across the Ajim-Jorf strait.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Route through the Gulf of Gabes staying OUTSIDE the extensive Djerba shallows/sandbanks; offshore waypoint west of the island before the Ajim-Jorf strait. Gulf of Gabes is very shallow -- Grok must respect the depth mask.

excluded_context_only.corridor: Gulf of Tunis <-> Sahel <-> Djerba as one continuous run
excluded_context_only.reason: Total coast is long; each sub-network is a separate short-hop cluster. Do not mint a single Tunis-to-Djerba super-corridor (>>70 nm).
